The client summary.json is written at line 371 through publisher.summary_address(), which is also the naming builder. Publish the filled report as a new platinum object, addressed by lib/opal_naming.py address() beside series.json.gz, manifest.json and summary.json, and written by the reporting-publish schedule (handler.py line 192 pattern). Not in the publisher today.

Serve it through a new route GET /api/scoped/investor-reporting/reporting/client/{client_id}/report on the irpt-49f-reporting-read lambda, under the summary's scope check (every account the document names must be covered; entry.py lines 332-345). Declared nowhere today.

Export bundle source: a filled-report source kind for the export. export/bundle.py and export/retained_export.py freeze only PATH A retained reports and PATH B performance_source series today, so the submit would have to pin the filled object's version. Not present today.

Export render host: infra/aws/ec2/investor-reporting-export/run-export-render.sh (line 29) and render_export.cjs print a print route from the frozen bundle. The print route has no filled-report template (portal render/ holds the performance, client-report and analysis documents). The host half names no live issuing seat in the files (its author is worker 0.9.0_WK_IRPT_BCKEND~4); the render host is stopped and starting it needs Andrew's per-use word (the host README).

Portal: the reader dashboard/report/reportRead.ts (the DB-f-501 cell; absent at HEAD) asks the proposed route for one client's filled report; ReportingTab.tsx mounts it in the Performance tab; the export composer export/resolveBundle.ts carries the filled report ref. export_path.words: The export document is built on a server host, not in the browser. Line 29 runs node render_export.cjs, which reads the frozen bundle from S3, opens the portal print route in Chromium and prints the PDF (the host README, line 27). The browser composes the bundle (portal export/resolveBundle.ts, composeExportBundle) and the server freezes it: PATH A carries a retained report by revision ref, PATH B carries a performance_source naming the platinum series (export/bundle.py line 191 reads those pins). Nothing in the export reads a filled report today.

proposed_route.words: A sibling of the summary route in reporting/entry.py: a new ROUTES key beside SUMMARY_ROUTE_KEY (line 92) served by a new operation that reads one platinum object the publisher writes at the naming builder's address for client=<id>, a report kind and not summary.json. It refuses unless the viewer's scope covers EVERY account the document names (accounts and unpublished ids), using the same _summary_named_accounts and _check_covered pair the summary uses (entry.py lines 317-344). The route owner must add: the route in api.tf beside the summary route (lines 34-37; the permission at line 49 already covers /reporting/*), the route key in docs/contracts/investor-reporting/v1/routes.json, the object kind in publisher.py and handler.py, the platinum address from lib/opal_naming.py address() only, and an IAM read on the new key. Shipping it is a deploy (WORLD).
